info.title: ForgeBase API
info.description: REST API over ForgeBase's SQL, collection and document engine. Errors are `{"error":{"code","message","request_id","details?"}}`. Until authentication ships (FB-20) every `/api/v1` request is anonymous and is denied with `401`; the `/api/v1` data API is versioned additively (ADR-0001 §6).

get.description: Query string: `format` (`json` default, `ndjson`, `csv`), plus `filter`, `p.<name>`, `sort`, `fields`. JSON is one array of records. The response is streamed page by page.

post.summary: Imports records from a JSON array, NDJSON or CSV body (streamed).
post.description: Query string: `format` = `json` (array of objects), `ndjson` or `csv`; defaults from `Content-Type` (`text/csv`, `application/x-ndjson`), else `json`. Stored in batches of 200, each all-or-nothing; the import stops at the first failing record and earlier batches stay committed (`error.details.imported` counts them).

details.description:
Structured context, e.g. per-field validation errors
(`{"fields": {"name": {"code": "required", "message": "..."}}}`).
Additive and optional (ADR-0001 §6).

request_id.description: Id of the request (also in the `x-request-id` response header).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

sql.description: SQL text; parameter values are never recorded.

statements.description: 1 to 1000 statements, run in one all-or-nothing transaction.

threshold_ms.description: Statements slower than this are logged; `0` logs every statement.
